text: {"quantities":[{"id":"q1","value":20,"unit":"minutes","kind":"count","span":"20 minutes to make the cake batter"},{"id":"q2","value":30,"unit":"minutes","kind":"count","span":"30 minutes to bake the cake"},{"id":"q3","value":2,"unit":"hours","kind":"count","span":"2 hours to cool"},{"id":"q4","value":10,"unit":"minutes","kind":"count","span":"10 minutes to frost the cake"},{"id":"q5","value":5,"unit":"","kind":"count","span":"ready to serve it at 5:00 pm"}],"plan":[{"op":"add","args":["q1","q2"],"out":"s1","note":"batter time plus bake time"},{"op":"add","args":["s1","q4"],"out":"s2","note":"plus frosting time gives total active minutes (before accounting for cooling)"},{"op":"sub","args":["q5","q3"],"out":"s3","note":"serve time minus the 2-hour cooling period, part of working backward to find the start time"}],"target":{"kind":"count","scope":"the latest time Jordan can start making the cake to serve it at 5:00 pm"},"dismissed":[]}
